discord_server_id_invalid: That is not a Discord server ID. It is a number of 17 to 20 digits: right-click the server in Discord and choose Copy Server ID.
discord_bot_token_invalid: Discord did not accept that bot token. Copy it again from the Bot page of your application.
discord_bot_not_in_server: The bot is not on that Discord server. Add it with the link from OAuth2 → URL Generator, then try again.
discord_import_expired: This import ran out. Look the server up again.
discord_import_running: This import is already bringing pictures over.
space_emoji_limit_reached: This space already has as many emoji as it can hold ({{max}}).
space_sticker_limit_reached: This space already has as many stickers as it can hold ({{max}}).
space_emoji_name_taken: This space already has an emoji with that name.
space_sticker_name_taken: This space already has a sticker with that name.
emoji_unavailable: This emoji belongs to a space you are not in.
decoration_not_found: That decoration does not exist any more.
decoration_name_invalid: Give the decoration a name of 1 to {{max}} characters on one line.
decoration_image_invalid: Upload a PNG, WebP or GIF picture of at most {{max}} MB.
decoration_limit_reached: You can keep at most {{max}} decorations of your own. Delete one to make another.
decoration_style_invalid: That name style cannot be drawn. Pick a look and its colours again.
decoration_reason_invalid: Give a reason of {{min}} to {{max}} characters.
